name: Seducing the Bad Boy
source:
Life seems fine – until the bad boy moves in next door. Will you be able to stay away? Secrets and drama are sure to follow.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
生活原本平静顺遂——直到那个坏小子搬到了隔壁。你当真能离他远远的吗？重重秘密与情感风波必将接踵而至。

[摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用[/url]]
